description.name: mgo_on_fe
description.purpose: Compare the wetting of the deposited layer between Fe-on-MgO (main text) and the inverted MgO-on-Fe stack. Flatness is measured over the deposited film in each case: Fe for femgo, MgO (Mg+O) for mgofe.

key_definitions.dZ_film: z(max)-z(min) over the deposited film (Mg+O for mgofe, Fe for femgo)

description.data_quality: The 5 completed mgofe searches are badly under-converged: per-seed best spans ~59 eV (~0.8 eV/atom) against ~0.09 eV/atom for femgo, and the structures are physically intact, so this is a failure to converge at 100 iterations, not a crash. The flat-film-is-lowest observation rests on 1 of 5 searches.
description.scope_bound: Boron-free; bounds the structural result only.
description.run_selection: completed searches only (budget 100); seed_5 stopped at 26 and is excluded; scratch trash/ excluded; iteration >= 10

headline.conclusion: qualified: the lowest structure found for MgO-on-Fe is a flat MgO film (opposite of Fe-on-MgO), but the search does not converge at 100 iterations (per-seed best spans ~0.8 eV/atom; only 1 of 5 searches reaches the flat film), so this is a weak/negative result, not a clean claim
